name: Air Fryer Fish Cakes with Roasted Pepper Sauce and Sweet Potato

components.name: Fish Cakes

ingredients.name: Raw skinless boneless cod fillets, finely chopped
Dry seasoned panko crumbs, divided between mixture and coating
Light mayonnaise to bind fish cakes
Dijon mustard to bind fish cakes
Fresh lemon juice mixed into fish cakes
Olive oil spray, weighed for air-frying

steps: Pat fish dry and air fry the raw cod at 200 C for about 6-9 minutes until fish reaches 63 C. Cool briefly, then flake into coarse pieces.

Mix flaked COOKED fish with finely diced onion, celery, one half of the beaten eggs, mayonnaise, Dijon, lemon juice, parsley, salt and 80 g of the panko. Shape into eight patties. Dip patties into remaining egg and press into remaining 60 g panko. Chill for 15-20 minutes to set.
Spray fish cakes with 15 ml oil and air fry in a single layer at 200 C for about 8-11 minutes, turning once, until browned and reheated thoroughly to 74 C. All raw egg binder must be cooked through.
Pack two fish cakes per person with sweet potato, spinach and sauce separately. Reheat cakes in air fryer; leave spinach and sauce cold.

components.name: Sweet Potato Wedges

ingredients.name: Raw sweet potato cut into small wedges

steps: Toss sweet potato wedges with 25 ml olive oil and air fry at 195 C for 15-22 minutes, shaking partway until tender and golden.

components.name: Pepper Sauce & Spinach
steps: Blend roasted peppers, light mayonnaise, lemon juice and paprika into a dipping sauce.

preservationAndReheating: Refrigerate cooked food promptly in shallow covered containers. Target within 2 hours, or 1 hour when ambient temperature exceeds 32 C.
Refrigerate at 4 C or below for 3-4 days maximum; for many fish and shrimp dishes, prioritize eating within 1-2 days for quality and freeze later-week cooked portions promptly.

Cook fish and crustaceans to 63 C (145 F) or applicable local food-safety standard, and reheat cooked leftovers to 74 C. For crab cakes containing egg binder and purchased cooked crab, reheat to 74 C.
When recipe includes rice, cool rapidly and refrigerate promptly; do not leave cooked rice at room temperature.
Freeze in suitable airtight food-safe containers. Defrost in refrigerator, not on counter. Re-crisp breading in an air fryer when possible.
Do not freeze fresh avocado, uncooked tomato/cucumber/cabbage salad, or mayonnaise/yogurt-based dressing unless kitchen-tested separately.
